title: Great tree skirt, inconvenient way to light
text: Great tree skirt, inconvenient way to light. I need to start by saying I really am impressed with this skirt.  It is large and a beautiful red plaid color. I kind of like the faux fur (might be a tad gawdy). This is really well made and a quality item. I deducted one star because of the lights and the way they did the battery. I actually turn my lights on my tree remotely now, however with this skirt, I need to bend down, find the switch and turn it on and off. Anyway, I will only be lighting it on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day as it is too difficult to put the lights on the skirt. They really should have thought that through.
